research_question: Can a prequential variable-order symbolic context tree, trained as a reward process rather than a row-wise regression or classifier, rank Tokyo Stock Exchange names from strictly prior OHLC paths with robust net open-to-close profit?

authority.purpose: retrospective falsification of a genuinely different representation and learning mechanism
authority.reason: The 2024-01-04 through 2025-07-31 outcomes have been repeatedly used by earlier project generations. This run can reject the family or qualify a frozen forward shadow, but cannot establish production performance.

non_overlap_with_prior_work.representation: Fixed symbolic words made from entire ordered prior-session paths, not rolling aggregates, TDnet text vectors, issuer graphs, calendar dummies, or fitted latent market regimes.
non_overlap_with_prior_work.model: A prequential hierarchical context-tree reward table with deterministic Bayesian-style backoff, not Ridge, logistic regression, pairwise rank regression, tree ensembles, nearest-title retrieval, causal uplift, distributional regression, or an ensemble of earlier model scores.
non_overlap_with_prior_work.update_rule: Outcomes are incorporated after each scored session and may first affect the following session. Earlier work predominantly refit supervised models by calendar month.

data_limitations: OHLC only: no volume, turnover, trading unit, bid, ask, auction imbalance, spread, slippage, futures, PTS, or TDnet body data
Historical parser input does not provide independent live receipt-time evidence
The same outcome period has been inspected by prior project generations

point_in_time_contract.candidate_universe: The preceding official session's ordinary-stock universe, with the existing RankerConfig price-history eligibility rules.
point_in_time_contract.feature_cutoff: A target-session context contains only tokens from sessions strictly earlier than the target date.
point_in_time_contract.outcome_update: The target-session open-to-close outcome is added to context statistics only after that session has been scored; it can influence no earlier prediction.
point_in_time_contract.missing_session: A prior-universe name without four target-session OHLC prices receives an explicit no-trade token. It is never silently removed from the sequence.
point_in_time_contract.source_failure: A source-incomplete scheduled session is retained as cash and is not reclassified as a no-event observation.
point_in_time_contract.tie_break: Higher context score, then security code ascending.

absolute_shape_token.description: One token per completed session from open-to-close return, overnight gap, range, and close location; a non-traded session is a separate token.

relative_shape_token.description: The same four completed-session quantities converted to deterministic within-session tertiles among traded rows before tokenization.

direction_token.description: A coarser long word from open-to-close and overnight directions, plus an explicit no-trade state.

symbolic_features.lag_rule: For every target row, depth one is the immediately preceding session token. Deeper contexts append older tokens in chronological order and never include the target-session token.

model.target: same-session open-to-close return in percentage points
model.training_weight: Each training date has total weight one before context aggregation.

backoff.parent: The next shallower suffix, ending at the global date-equal clipped-return mean.

model.refit_schedule: Prequential daily state update; score first, then add that date's eligible observed outcomes.

registered_candidates.score: absolute-shape context tree at maximum depth 3
relative-shape context tree at maximum depth 3
direction context tree at maximum depth 6
unweighted arithmetic mean of CT01, CT02, and CT03

control.purpose: Same source, universe, schedule, costs, and capacity comparator; not a candidate in the symbolic family.

evaluation.cash_rule: Every scheduled session has exactly capacity slots. Missing selections and unexecuted slots remain cash and incur no cost.

bootstrap.multiplicity_adjustment: Bonferroni across all 8 registered candidate/capacity variants

checks: net mean at 40 bp is positive across all 266 scheduled sessions
net mean at 40 bp is positive in discovery, confirmation_a, and confirmation_b separately
net mean at 40 bp remains positive after removing the 10 best scheduled days
net mean at 40 bp remains positive after replacing every selection from the 10 most profitable security codes with cash
at least 9 of 13 calendar months have positive mean net return at 40 bp
the Bonferroni-adjusted one-sided 90% moving-block lower bound for candidate minus same-capacity C00 control is non-negative
at least 50 unique security codes are selected
no single security code exceeds 10% of all signaled slots
qualification_gate.result_authority: Passing can freeze a new forward-shadow candidate only. Failing rejects the candidate/capacity variant. Neither outcome changes production or order permissions.

anti_leakage_tests: Mutating target-session OHLC cannot change that session's symbolic contexts or scores.
Mutating future-session OHLC cannot change any earlier context or score.
Every training outcome date is strictly earlier than its prediction date.
Scoring is performed before the same date's outcome update.
Row order changes cannot alter security-code tie ordering.
Repeated runs produce byte-equivalent result semantics and identical picks.
stop_rule: Run all 8 registered variants once. Do not alter bins, context depths, backoff strengths, consensus weights, capacity, gates, or score period after viewing results. Any new design requires a new protocol and new untouched outcomes.
